annotations.title: Redline: explain changes between two versions

description: Redline: explain changes between two versions — Compare two versions of a contract, policy, terms page or any document and get a reviewed redline. Offline sentence-level diff (modified / added / removed, word changes, deterministic flags for changed numbers, dates, negation and key legal terms like shall/may, liability, termination, fees), then Workers AI classifies each change (category, material/minor/cosmetic, who it favors, plain-English impact) and lists top concerns and questions to ask. Params: old=, new= (up to 15,000 chars each), optional context= (e.g. lease, SaaS terms) and perspective= (e.g. tenant). Includes a Markdown table. Not legal advice. Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).
